Overview Books Scans Messages System

At a glance

Use Books to add, edit or delete catalogue records. Scans and Messages have their own sections.

The starter collection contains 20 books checked for title and author. Genres are Bookrift labels. Open a reference to review the source. Older unreviewed records are under Needs review and are excluded from recommendations.

Deleting an unused record removes it permanently. Books saved by readers can be rejected instead.
